entries.title: Psalms 13:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

entries.title: Psalms 13:2
segments: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, [Having] sorrow in my heart daily? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?

entries.title: Psalms 13:3
segments: Consider [and] hear me, O LORD my God; Enlighten my eyes, Lest I sleep the [sleep of] death;

entries.title: Psalms 13:4
segments: Lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed against him"; [Lest] those who trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

entries.title: Psalms 13:5
segments: But I have trusted in Your mercy; My heart shall rejoice in Your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 13:6
segments: I will sing to the LORD, Because He has dealt bountifully with me.
